diagnosis.cause: `poetry` is not installed; the docs assume it is.

actions.command: command -v poetry >/dev/null || { if command -v pip >/dev/null || command -v pip3 >/dev/null; then (pip install poetry || pip3 install poetry); else apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl >/dev/null && curl -sSL https://install.python-poetry.org | POETRY_HOME=/opt/poetry python3 - && ln -sf /opt/poetry/bin/poetry /usr/local/bin/poetry; fi; }

doc.command: command -v poetry >/dev/null || { if command -v pip >/dev/null || command -v pip3 >/dev/null; then (pip install poetry || pip3 install poetry); else apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl >/dev/null && curl -sSL https://install.python-poetry.org | POETRY_HOME=/opt/poetry python3 - && ln -sf /opt/poetry/bin/poetry /usr/local/bin/poetry; fi; }
